title: Discover new capabilities in the App Intents framework
description: Level up your App Intents adoption with advanced features to make it faster, more flexible, and more relevant. Find out how ValueRepresentation and RelevantEntities make your content more discoverable and allow it to travel across apps, EntityCollection improves performance, and SyncableEntity let you scale across devices. Explore richer parameter types including union values and long-running intents that handle cancellation gracefully.

codeSnippets.title: Share structured entities with ValueRepresentation
Register relevant entities with RelevantEntities
Handle large entity sets with EntityCollection
Make entity IDs stable with SyncableEntity
Accept multiple types with @UnionValue
Run beyond 30 s with LongRunningIntent + CancellableIntent
Control which process runs your intent with ExecutionTargets

resources.title: Adopting App Intents to support system experiences
resources.description: Create app intents and entities so people can use your app’s content and actions across system experiences.

resources.title: App Intents
resources.description: Make content and actions discoverable by Apple Intelligence and support system experiences like Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts, and widgets.
